committee: *Presentation of Legislative Certificate 326-38 (COR) - Senator Joe San Agustin
location: Scottish Rite Center in Agana Heights
title: Håfa Adai! Please join me as I present Legislative Certificate 326-38 to the newly inducted and appointed officers of the Micronesia Masonic Lodge No. 173 on their induction for Masonic Year 2026-2027. The presentation will take place on Saturday, March 21, 2026, at 3pm in the Scottish Rite Center in Agana Heights. Your participation in recognizing the dedication of these officers is appreciated.
